name: jev
description: Structured decisions for coding agents: which installed skill fits the request, and what is wrong with the change a turn just made.

interface.shortDescription: Typed decisions: skill routing and post-turn judgment
interface.longDescription: Jev answers typed questions about your session with calibrated probabilities. Ask which installed skill fits a request, or whether the change a turn just made claims more than it verified. Requires a TypeSafe or OpenRouter API key, set up with /jev:setup.
